body: China Airlines flight CI840 was scheduled to depart Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport (KHH) for Kaohsiung at 18:35 on October 28, operated by a Boeing 737-800 registered B-18665. While the aircraft was taxiing for departure, it encountered a large hole in the taxiway pavement; its wheels became trapped in the depression and the jet could not move, so the flight never departed. Video and photos posted by passengers on Threads show the aircraft stopped on the apron at night, with broken pavement and scattered debris beneath the fuselage near the landing gear as ground crew in high-visibility vests worked around it.

Passengers said they felt strong bumps while taxiing, and the captain announced that the aircraft had left the paved surface and would be inspected. Cabin crew later announced a controlled disembarkation: all passengers left the aircraft and were taken away by shuttle bus, and China Airlines arranged hotel accommodation in Bangkok, leaving them to stay an extra night instead of returning to Kaohsiung. The aircraft itself also remained in Bangkok overnight. Passengers posting about the incident said Kaohsiung Airport's curfew had added to their worries about the trip home before the hotel arrangement was confirmed.

As of first publication, neither China Airlines nor Suvarnabhumi Airport had released an official account of why the pavement failed, whether the aircraft was damaged, or where responsibility for the incident lay; the only accounts available at that point were the videos and posts published by passengers on board. Official statements and further developments followed the next day, as set out in the update below.

Update: China Airlines later said CI840 had been affected by runway damage at Bangkok and by Kaohsiung Airport's curfew, and that the flight was moved to the following day; the aircraft was inspected and confirmed safe, and passengers were provided with meals, accommodation and transport. Flight-tracking records show B-18665 returned to service on October 29, operating CI2840 from Bangkok to Kaohsiung and then CI7840 from Kaohsiung to Taipei, while that evening's CI840 was operated by a replacement aircraft, B-18651, and arrived in Kaohsiung.

On the Thai side, the damaged section of runway 02R was targeted to reopen at about 18:00 on October 29 once a repair-surface density check had passed. Thailand's transport minister said repairs were complete and an investigation was under way, with no established conclusion yet on what caused the pavement to fail. The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand also instructed the airport operator to fully inspect its runways, taxiways and aprons, especially high-risk areas, and recommended the use of non-destructive testing equipment; five flights were affected in total.
en.summary: China Airlines flight CI840, a Boeing 737-800 (B-18665) scheduled to fly from Bangkok to Kaohsiung on the evening of October 28, became stuck while taxiing when its wheels dropped into a large hole in the taxiway pavement at Suvarnabhumi Airport; passengers disembarked and stayed an extra night in Bangkok, according to videos and posts published by passengers. China Airlines later said the aircraft had been inspected and confirmed safe, and it returned to service on October 29.
en.title: China Airlines CI840 Boeing 737 Stuck in Taxiway Pavement Hole at Bangkok

body: 中華航空CI840班機原訂10月28日晚間18時35分自曼谷素萬那普機場飛往高雄小港機場，由波音737-800客機（註冊編號B-18665）執飛。飛機在地面滑行準備起飛時，滑行道地面出現一個大破洞，機輪卡進凹陷處、動彈不得，航班因此未能起飛。機上旅客在Threads發布的影像顯示，飛機在夜間停在停機坪上，起落架附近的鋪面破裂、碎塊散落，身穿反光背心的地勤人員在機旁處理。
旅客貼文指出，滑行期間機上眾人感受到很大的顛簸，機長廣播表示飛機已滑出鋪面、正在接受檢查。其後空服員宣布「管制離機」，全體旅客下機並搭乘接駁車離開，華航安排旅客在曼谷住宿，較原訂行程多停留一晚；涉事飛機也留在曼谷過夜。有旅客提到，高雄小港機場（KHH）的宵禁一度讓他們擔心無法當晚返家，所幸華航安排了住宿。
發稿當時，華航與素萬那普機場尚未公布破洞的成因、飛機是否受損，以及責任歸屬；當時公開的資訊僅有機上旅客發布的影像與貼文。官方說法與後續發展於隔日陸續出現，整理如以下更新。
後續發展：華航其後說明，CI840是受曼谷機場跑道損壞與高雄小港機場宵禁影響，航班延至隔日，飛機經檢查確認安全，旅客獲安排餐食、住宿與交通。航班追蹤紀錄顯示，B-18665已於10月29日復飛，先執飛CI2840自曼谷返回高雄，再接續CI7840飛往台北；10月29日晚間的CI840則改由另一架飛機（B-18651）執飛，並已抵達高雄。
泰國方面，受損的02R跑道區段在修復表面密度檢查通過後，目標於10月29日晚間約18時重新開放；泰國交通部方面表示修復已完成、事故調查進行中，但破洞成因尚未有定論。泰國民航局並要求機場營運單位全面檢查跑道、滑行道與停機坪，特別是高風險區域，並建議導入非破壞性檢測設備；此次事件共影響5個航班。
zh.summary: 中華航空CI840班機原訂10月28日晚間自曼谷飛往高雄，波音737-800客機（B-18665）在素萬那普機場滑行準備起飛時，機輪卡進滑行道地面的一個大破洞、動彈不得；旅客下機後被安排在曼谷多停留一晚。華航其後表示飛機經檢查確認安全，該機已於10月29日復飛。
zh.title: 華航CI840曼谷滑行遇地面破洞 737機輪卡陷、旅客滯留一晚
